digest.component_or_area: rebar search CLI and library interface
propositions: rebar search currently returns full ticket bodies including descriptions and all comment text, causing excessive output size (203 KB baseline) inappropriate for discovery workflows

search output must project to eight canonical fields (ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, snippet) with summary and snippet each capped at 240 characters including ellipsis
summary field is derived from stored summary if non-empty, otherwise from normalized description, falling back to null if both are absent or whitespace-only

snippet field contains the first matched positive free-text term in case-preserving form from any searchable field (title, description, tags, id, alias, Jira key, comments) with bounded 240-character context, but predicate-only and negation-only queries return null snippet
--output json|llm flag must be added with json as default; --output=bogus exits with error code 2; --full --output=llm is rejected as incompatible; --full alone preserves legacy full TicketState JSON
MCP search output and public library typing must distinguish SearchResult (summary default) from TicketState (full) with typed overloads and dedicated schema bindings
